text_markup: The {term:trigger cost} of each paid ability is the first part of that ability's text. It is followed by a colon (:) and then the ability's effect. See {ref:sec_paid_abilities} for more details on paid abilities.
text_plain: The trigger cost of each paid ability is the first part of that ability's text. It is followed by a colon (:) and then the ability's effect. See section 9.5 for more details on paid abilities.
